title: Skew-aware mini-slate sampler for quant calibration
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: design and deliver a lightweight, per-domain sampling component (mini-slate sampler) for producing calibration packs used by FP8/INT8 quantization workflows. The sampler must preserve production prompt "shape" across domains while being robust to heavy-tailed traffic (fractured long-tail prompts) and bursty recency effects. Requirements: stratify by domain + context-length + response-length + token-entropy; maintain a minimum tail coverage floor so rare-but-critical intents are not dropped; provide recency-weighted decay tunables; emit diagnostic weights and cohort fingerprints for downstream validation. Output format: deterministic list of example IDs with seed + provenance metadata for auditability. Acceptance criteria: 1) calibration packs cover >=95% of high-utility token mass for top 10 domains (measured by token-weighted KL on validation set), 2) per-domain worst-case regret <1.5% relative to manual curated pack baseline on INT8 accuracy tests, 3) generation runtime for sampler <2m for 100k candidate pool. Deliverables: sampling algorithm, sampling service sketch (k8s job), unit tests, experiment notebook, dashboard for calibration pack health and drift. Long-term: tie into Optimize recommendations to suggest quant profiles per domain based on pack results.
comments: 2025-02-19 - Kickoff: reviewed current calibration pack corpus with Research. Noted heavy skew: top 3 domains constitute ~72% token mass in last 30 days. Agreed to enforce a tail floor by domain.

2025-02-22 - Design draft posted: Confluence doc -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Skew-aware+Mini-Slate+Sampler (working doc). Key decision: use stratified reservoir sampling per domain + context-length buckets with adjustable decay.

2025-02-25 - Trade-offs discussion in sync: Miguel O. raised concerns about deterministic reproducibility when applying decay; decision: include explicit seed and a "decay_epoch" field in provenance to make packs replayable.

2025-02-28 - Prototype run: local job sampled 50k candidates -> produced 2k-element packs. Initial INT8 eval vs curated baseline: mean accuracy delta +0.3% on frequent intents, -1.1% on rare intents. Action: increase tail floor weight from 3% to 8%.

2025-03-03 - PR opened for sampler core algorithm: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821. Seeking review from infra and research. Notes: added deterministic sharding by tenant and domain to support per-tenant packs later.

2025-03-05 - PM feedback (Priya Patel): please add telemetry hooks to emit per-domain token-mass coverage and a small summary JSON with top-N exemplar fingerprints for audit. Also asked that the sampler write pack manifests to GCS under gs://redwood-calibration/packs/{date}/.
Next steps: finalize decay hyperparameters, add integration test that runs sampling on a replay of last 7 days of production traffic, wire up a Grafana dashboard for pack health metrics.
